nl_spans.text: single-wheel ABS hydraulic regulator is implemented as a three-state FSM coupled with a PID-based slip controller
nl_spans.rationale: defines the discrete supervisor scope and three-state nature

nl_spans.text: wheel speed and vehicle speed compute slip ratio; PID output drives the Stateflow supervisor rather than valves directly
nl_spans.rationale: grounds slp as an external plant/PID input to the FSM and excludes continuous dynamics from the DSL

nl_spans.text: increase/hold/decrease state actions assign k1/k2/n values
nl_spans.rationale: state/action obligations for valve and pump outputs

nl_spans.text: four transition guards split slip-error space: <=0.01, >0.01, <-0.01, >=-0.01
discrete supervisor maps slip-error thresholds to valve/pump actions while continuous wheel-slip dynamics remain in plant model

obligations.evidence_text: three-state FSM; Figure 6 initial arrow enters increase
PID slip-error output drives Stateflow supervisor; continuous dynamics remain in plant
continuous wheel-slip dynamics remain in plant model
required_fields: no continuous dynamics encoded in discrete FSM

external_input_ledger.evidence: NL says continuous wheel-slip dynamics remain in plant; paper_content lines 183-185 say PID slip-error output drives FSM action decision; SD-4 external-input role ledger detected slp.

scenarios.name: S001_default_enters_increase_outputs
scenarios.reachable_prefix_witness: root initial arrow in Figure 6 enters increase

scenarios.name: S002_increase_to_hold_at_upper_boundary
scenarios.reachable_prefix_witness: default initial enters increase before slp=0.01 guard is evaluated

scenarios.name: S003_hold_to_increase_positive_error
scenarios.reachable_prefix_witness: default -> increase; with slp<=0.01, increase -> hold; then slp refreshes externally to 0.02
scenarios.state_snapshot_justification: hold output snapshot k1=0,k2=0,n=0 comes from hold during action; slp is external refreshed input

scenarios.name: S004_hold_to_decrease_negative_error
scenarios.reachable_prefix_witness: default -> increase; with slp<=0.01, increase -> hold; then slp refreshes externally to -0.02
scenarios.state_snapshot_justification: hold output snapshot k1=0,k2=0,n=0 comes from hold during action; slp is external refreshed input

scenarios.name: S005_decrease_to_hold_at_lower_boundary
scenarios.reachable_prefix_witness: default -> increase; increase -> hold at slp<=0.01; hold -> decrease at slp<-0.01; then slp refreshes externally to -0.01
scenarios.state_snapshot_justification: decrease output snapshot k1=0,k2=1,n=500 comes from decrease during action; slp is external refreshed input

mutations.mutant: guard threshold/direction too strict: slp <= 0.01 replaced by slp < -0.01
wrong transition target: hold positive branch targets decrease
wrong effect value: decrease n=500 replaced by n=0
guard direction flip: slp < -0.01 replaced by slp > -0.01
wrong effect value: hold k1=0 replaced by k1=1

limitations: NFRR is single self-assessment; no independent adjudication or human/domain-expert signoff was performed.
The FCSTM covers the discrete three-state hydraulic supervisor only; continuous slip dynamics, PID internals, AMESim hydraulic equations, and vehicle dynamics remain out of model scope.

Some SD-6 scenarios use runtime_hotstart_surrogate for reachable middle states because current SD-6 scenarios do not support step-level external variable refresh; each such scenario includes a reachable-prefix witness and external-input ledger.
DMR is targeted but not exhaustive over every possible threshold perturbation and every output variable in every state.
